TOOL INVENTORY SOFTWARE

Turn your tool list into a living inventory.

Import your spreadsheet, give each item an identity, and let the crew update where it is through a scan.

Import your tools →

Inventory is more than a count.

A useful construction tool inventory tells you which item you have, whether it is available, where it is, and what happened last. Fieldmark makes all four visible in one record.

Import first

Start from the Excel or CSV tool list your business already uses.

Assign IDs

Create a simple asset ID and QR label for each trackable item.

Audit faster

Find a specific tool or location from a phone before making a call.

Tools and consumables are not the same

Use Fieldmark for the equipment and tools that need an accountable handoff. Consumables such as fasteners or tape often need quantity control, not the same location and responsibility history.

From the job site back to the shop

A scan can move an item to a job site, worker, truck, or back to the shop. That simple flow makes your inventory state useful between scheduled audits.
